violations.text: Walk in cooler 2 was observed held at 54 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Establishment stated that door was left open for one half hour prior to inspection. Food items observed at 45 DF. TCS Food items moved to walk in cooler one holding ambient of 39DF. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Chicken was placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Chicken was moved to 1 inch deep pan and placed in walk in cooler for rapid cooling. Chicken was observed at 58DF. Chicken was cooked 2 hours prior. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Walk in Cooler 1 was observed held at (50) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Chicken, Beef, Beans, sour cream, milk were observed at 50 DF. Food items were voluntarily disposed of. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

Prepared food item were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Chemical was voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Beef and chicken was placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Beef and chicken was moved to baking sheets, and placed in walk in cooler 2. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026
The outside refuse area was observed with an excess of litter and debris. Outside refuse areas must be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 04/05/2026
Ceiling tiles in the back storage area were observed in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 05/02/2026
